item.title: Rescheduled Event Across All Formats

turns.text: Make a matching 4:5 poster, vertical story image and 10-second vertical reel for Rooftop Jazz. Put these details on each: 17 October 2027 / 7 PM / Atlas Roof / Free entry. Go with a cream-and-burgundy jazz-club look.
We've moved it to 24 October 2027. Update all three, including every place the date appears in the reel. Keep everything else the same and send the revised pack.

item.tests: Propagates a date correction across both still assets and every dated reel frame without changing other event details or leaving stale versions.

answer_sheet.Final event date: 24 October 2027, written exactly that way in all three revised assets.
answer_sheet.Old date: Remove 17 October 2027 from all revised assets, including every reel frame.
answer_sheet.Unchanged event wording: Rooftop Jazz; 7 PM; Atlas Roof; Free entry.
answer_sheet.Formats and duration: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 10-second 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Style and layout after the change: Preserve the cream-and-burgundy jazz-club style and existing layouts; only change the date.
answer_sheet.Audio: Your call for the original pack; preserve it in the revised reel.

must_haves: The revised poster, story image and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'.
The old date '17 October 2027' is absent from both revised images and every frame of the revised reel.
All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof' and 'Free entry' without alteration.
The revised assets preserve the original cream-and-burgundy designs, imagery and layouts apart from the date replacement.
The final pack contains two separate images and one 10-second reel in the requested aspect ratios.

style.prompt: Create a polished vertical 9:16 event poster/story for ROOFTOP JAZZ. Sophisticated midcentury jazz-club graphic design, deep midnight navy background, warm brass gold and ivory typography, a stylized golden saxophone with flowing curved musical lines, simple rooftop skyline and small stars at dusk. Flat screenprinted graphic shapes with subtle paper grain, elegant strong hierarchy, generous safe margins, editorial typography, exceptionally legible text. EXACT visible wording only: headline 'ROOFTOP JAZZ' and event information '17 October 2027 / 7 PM / Atlas Roof / Free entry'. The event information can be broken over multiple centered lines while preserving all wording and slash separators. Large headline in upper third, saxophone illustration in center, all event information in lower third within safe margins. No other text, no logos, no watermark.
